newsitem.title: SINGAPORE: Fujitsu, Indian partner win Yemen telecom project.
newsitem.headline: Fujitsu, Indian partner win Yemen telecom project.

text.p: Japan's Fujitsu Ltd and Telecommunications Consultants India (TCIL) have jointly won a 3.6 billion yen project to expand telecommunications infrastucture in Yemen, a Fujitsu spokesman said on Friday.
He said Fujitsu would supply digital switches, 50,000 telephone lines and fibre-optic transmission equipment, while TCIL would be responsible for the overall coordination of the project.
The full turn-key project was due to be completed in December 1998, he told Reuters.
Fujitsu and TCIL have formed a partnership to pursue telecommunications business in India, Africa and the Middle East, and the project their first, the spokesman said.
Fujitsu expected the partnership to give the Japanese company an edge in India, where demand for telecom equipment is expected to boom following deregulation now under way , he said.
